# S4.16a — C1 model-router depth + model-plane cache depth

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.15` (PR #79) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the C1 model-router depth (§5b.2) and the model-plane
cache depth (`R-2.3.4` C1 slice). `hh-gateway`'s router gains
the full C1 policy family — `select_with` executes
`fallback_chain`, `capability_filter`, `cost_cap`,
`latency_cap`, `quality_target` and `health_aware` over the
sealed `ModelRoleTable` through a `RoutingViews` evidence
bundle (`PricingView`/`QualityPriorView`/`MigrationView` +
`HealthView`/`project_health`) that fails closed on absent
evidence: `NoPrice` is never a zero-cost fallback, a missing
quality prior excludes the candidate (aggregating to
`ChainExhausted`), and a cross-profile move without a
migration projection refuses `MigrationLossExceeded` (G-3,
G-5 — ADR-0309 D1). C4 `learned` refuses `PolicyInvalid` —
no C1 kind silently degrades to `static`.

Retry-vs-reroute is executable: `on_attempt_failed` +
`AttemptState` drive `error_actions` (a data map with
`then`-chaining) to `AttemptDisposition::{Retry,
CompactThenRetry, Reroute, GiveUp}` — `compact_then_retry`
compacts under the old profile exactly once (ADR-0122 d.3),
`reroute` releases the live reservation before reserving the
next target, obeys `allowed_classes[]`/`max_reroutes`, and
re-runs the guards on the new target; `GiveUpReason` is the
closed terminal sum (ADR-0309 D2). `lower`/`lift` round-trip
MCP/ACP `modelPreferences` exactly on `preferences` with
`no_slot` loss reporting, and lifted preferences attenuate —
they may exclude binding members but never add candidates or
widen authority (G-6, CC2). `explain` folds the route
decisions into the trace-viewer explanation.

The cache layer gains `project_cache_view` — the IR-1 fold
of the durable prefix into `(facts, invalidations)` feeding
`expect_cache_state`. `CacheCallFact.closed` distinguishes
completed / terminal-failed / in-flight calls; version-stamp
deltas attribute `dialect_change`/`profile_version`/
`tool_set_change`/`definition_version`/`marker_policy`;
`relowered` rows emit `relower` (suppressing the coincident
`profile_version`); `cache_invalidating` rows classify by
class prefix — `context.*` → `context_edit`,
`control.compute.*` → `parameter_change`, which is how an
effort change under `cache_invalidation_on_change` lands its
miss reason (AC-R-2.3.3-15, ADR-0309 D4).

Ensembles are k ledgered calls (AC-R-2.3.2-10): `hh-control`'s
new `run_ensemble` executes `EnsembleProcedure{sample_k_vote,
k}` as exactly `k` members — each routed through
`select_with` under its own `model_call_id` + reservation,
member refusals typed (`InvalidK`/`SelectRefused`/
`MemberFailed`), one `EnsembleReducer` verdict, and a
`slice_consumption` of Σ member charges + the reducer's
(ADR-0309 D6). `hh-budget`'s `ArmSpec::ensemble_k` declares
the factor; `validate_match` refuses a k-vs-1 (or mixed-k)
comparison under every mode but `matched_total` with
`RefusalReason::EnsembleKvs1` — per-member spend only matches
at the totals (CC9).

Requirement ids: `R-2.3.2`, `R-2.3.4` (+ the AC-R-2.3.3-15
effort leg).

## Changes

- **`crates/hh-gateway`** — `router.rs`: `select_with`,
  `RoutingViews` + view traits (`PricingView`,
  `QualityPriorView`, `MigrationView`, `HealthView`) with
  fail-closed defaults (`NoPricing`, `NoQualityPrior`,
  `NoMigration`, `NoHealth`), `project_health` +
  `TargetHealth`/`TableHealth`, the C1 `RoutingPolicyKind`
  execution arms, `on_attempt_failed` + `AttemptState` +
  `AttemptDisposition` + `GiveUpReason` + `ErrorAction::then`,
  `BudgetPort::release`, `lower`/`lift`, `explain`,
  `MigrationLossBound` — all re-exported via `lib.rs`.
  `cache.rs`: `CacheCallFact.closed`, `CacheView`,
  `project_cache_view` (the IR-1 durable-prefix fold).
- **`crates/hh-control`** — `ensemble.rs` (new):
  `EnsembleKind{sample_k_vote}`, `EnsembleProcedure`,
  `run_ensemble`, `MemberExec`/`EnsembleReducer`/`VoteReducer`
  ports, `EnsembleOutcome` (per-member `MemberOutcome`s with
  routing decisions + charges, verdict, tally,
  `slice_consumption`), `EnsembleRefusal` typed sum;
  `compute.rs`: the AC-R-2.3.3-15 ladder/step-up test leg.
- **`crates/hh-budget`** — `ArmSpec::ensemble_k` +
  `validate_match`'s `EnsembleKvs1` commensurability refusal
  (`MatchRefusal::IncommensurableMatch`).
- **`crates/hh-lab`** — `ArmSpec::ensemble_k` on the lab
  record with JSON round-trip; exemplar fixtures propagated.
- **`crates/hh-embed`** — `ensemble_k` decode/projection in
  `eval_ops`/`analysis_ops`; test fixtures updated.
- **`crates/hh-experiment` / `crates/hh-results`** — test
  fixture literals propagated.

## Tests

- `hh-gateway` — `tests/model_plane.rs` 26 → **44** (18 new):
  fallback-chain ordering, capability filter, cost cap,
  latency cap, quality prior ranking + `ChainExhausted`,
  health-aware ranking + projection/cooldown, migration
  bound, lifted-preference attenuation, lift/lower
  round-trip, retry→reroute, reroute bounds/allowed-classes,
  compact-then-retry once, explain fold, cache-view fold,
  IR-1 version-stamp attribution, failed-call state, effort
  `parameter_change`; `golden_streams` +2.
- `hh-control` — ensemble 3 (k-routed-calls/verdict/slice,
  k bounds, typed member refusal) + effort ladder; lib 121/121.
- `hh-budget` — `ensemble_kvs1_refuses_without_matched_total`
  (matched-total admit + refuse otherwise).

## Deferrals

- **Opened:** `DF-S4.16a-1` — K6 semantic cache + verifier
  (AC-R-2.3.4-12): embedding lookup, the `verifier_verdict`
  gate, `readers` scoping, the poisoning fixture, per-profile
  `false_hit_rate`. K6 is spec-staged C2 and its design
  surface is OQ-312 (WS-G3/WS-I2/WS-C4, due Stage 5); the
  manifest assigns it to **S5.1** — "the K6 semantic cache
  with the mandatory verifier and `readers` scoping
  (`R-2.3.4²`)". The `model.cache.resolved{kind: semantic}`
  record already carries `verifier_verdict`/`readers`/`scope`.
- **Closed:** none.
